ownership.quote: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is Google Cloud's managed platform to build, deploy, and scale AI agents.

stage.note: Agent Engine / Agent Runtime is a product line within Google Cloud, itself a division of Alphabet Inc., a publicly traded company. Not independently funded; no separate funding rounds exist for this product.

note: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agent Runtime/Agent Engine and Agent Sandbox are products of Google Cloud, a division of Alphabet Inc. (public company, NASDAQ: GOOGL/GOOG). There is no independent funding history, accelerator participation, or stand-alone revenue figure for this specific product — it is backed entirely by Alphabet's balance sheet.
